messages:
Brynn (PM): Need a compact v1->v2 compatibility playbook focused on chat, embeddings, and tool calls. low friction, auditable notices, and clear rollback gates.
Jordan (Eng): I'll own runtime checklist and shim design. require streaming parity and tokenization checks.
Manraj (Runtime): Runtime constraints: exact streaming chunk parity, kv-cache mapping doc required, quantized fallbacks may alter tokenization. propose p95 latency regression <10% and quality delta <0.5% for GA.
Sasha (Product Eng): Contract rules: accept legacy headers on v2 with `x-compat-mode: v1`, maintain structured-output keys unless opt-in, map new error codes to legacy codes.
Diego (CSE): Migration windows: Hosted 90d warnings -> 180d removal; Dedicated 120d default + extensions; Private min 120d upgrade window. include curl examples and admin checklist.
Ava (Legal): Deprecation notices must be archived; send two business-day notices before removal; templates saved to legal storage and SOC copied.
Brynn (PM): Rollout proposal: internal 48h canary -> 5% external canary -> regional ramp 10->50->100 over 2 weeks. feature-flagged shim during ramp.
Jordan (Eng): Shim behavior: if `x-compat-mode: v1` header present route to adapter; when shimmed add `compatibility_shim` with reason. preserve streaming and tool-call wireformat.
Manraj (Runtime): Telemetry contract: eval-quality delta, p50/p95/p99 latency vs v1, 5xx anomaly detection (alert if 2x baseline in 5m).
Sasha (Product Eng): Launch checklist: contract diff signoff, SDK minor bump + tests, canary telemetry within thresholds, rollback playbook validated, migration docs published.
Diego (CSE): Migration doc will include migration steps, sample curl, SDK pin guidance, and admin checklist. sample:
`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "x-compat-mode: v1" https://api.redwood.inference/v2/chat`
Brynn (PM): Owners and deadlines: Jordan runtime+shim EOD+2 (2221200000); Manraj telemetry+rollback EOD+2; Sasha contract+SDK EOD+3; Diego migration guide EOD+4; Ava legal templates EOD+5.
Jordan (Eng): Question: require before/after examples for any tool-call signature changes?
Sasha (Product Eng): Yes, include before/after payloads and an automated eval for enterprise pilots.
deploy-bot: reminder set for v2-cutover review in #product on 2022-06-18 16:00 UTC.
Brynn (PM): Publishing draft to docs and opening early-adopter channel. closing thread unless blockers.
